# diffnotes.tech

> > Tech blog covering AI coding assistants, developer tools, and automation workflows with focus on Claude Code, MCP servers, and AI agents.

diffnotes.tech provides in-depth guides, reviews, and analyses of AI-powered development tools, particularly Claude Code by Anthropic, along with practical workflows for integrating AI agents into software development. The site covers topics from token optimization and autonomous coding to multi-agent systems and game engine integration.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code
- Anthropic
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- AI coding assistants
- AI agents
- Developer tools
- Context management
- Token optimization
- Code generation
- GitHub Copilot
- Cursor
- CLI tools
- Autonomous coding
- Game engine integration
- Security scanning
